sentences.text: Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that with respect to the grievance of the petitioner, he intends to file a fresh representation before respondent No.3/Collector, District Bhind and directions are sought to be issued to respondent No.3/Collector, District Bhind to decide the same and if such directions are issued, the grievance of the petitioner would be redressed.
Per contra, learned counsel for respondents No.3 to 5/State has no objection if such directions are issued.

Looking to the innocuous prayer made by the counsel for the petitioner, the petition is disposed of with a direction to the petitioner to file a fresh representation before respondent No.3/Collector,
District Bhind along with a copy of this order within a period of seven days from the date of receipt of certified copy and in turn respondent No.3/Collector, District Bhind is directed to decide the said representation filed by the petitioner as expeditiously as possible preferably within a period of four weeks from the date of filing of the same.
With the aforesaid directions, the petition stands disposed off.
E- copy/Certified copy as per rules and directions.
